Spec: `/workspace/dev/spec/cli-and-errors.md` — 90 cases in `/workspace/dev/cases/cli-and-errors/` (all re-verified deterministic, byte-for-byte).

RULES ESTABLISHED (most surprising first)

1. `[PYI-<n>:ERROR] Failed to execute script 'test9' due to unhandled exception!` is appended to stderr after every Python traceback — `<n>` is the **PID**, so it is not reproducible. Harness must normalise `\[PYI-\d+:ERROR\]`.
2. Tracebacks contain **no source-code lines** (PyInstaller strips them). Each frame is exactly `  File "yaml/scanner.py", line N, in fn`; first frame is always `  File "test9.py", line 8, in <module>`. Frame lists are per-error-site and must be hard-coded (recorded for all 54 error cases).
3. `["--a","-5"]` works but `["--a","-x"]` fails. The negative-number escape hatch is Python `re` `^-\d+$|^-\d*\.\d+$` where `\d` is **Unicode Nd**: `-١٢`(U+0661/2), `-５`(U+FF15), `-۱.۲` are accepted as values; `-²`(No), `-一`, `-1e5`, `-1.`, `-1_0` are rejected with `argument --a: expected one argument`.
4. Second escape hatch: a value containing an **ASCII 0x20 space** is always a value (`-x y`, `- a`, `- ` OK). NBSP and TAB do not count (`-<NBSP>5`, `-<TAB>` → error).
5. `-h ` (trailing space) still errors, because the short-prefix check (`V[:2]=="-h"`) runs *before* the space check. Full 9-step classification order is in spec §5.
6. `["--a","--","x"]` → `expected one argument`. `--` cannot be skipped to reach an optional's value (argparse strips `-*` from the nargs pattern of optionals → pattern is `(A)`).
7. An unconsumed `--` **stays in extras**: `["--a","1","--"]` → `unrecognized arguments: --`; `["--a","1","--","x","--"]` → `unrecognized arguments: -- x --`.
8. Missing `--a` **beats** unknown options: `["--b"]`, `["-a"]`, `["-x"]`, `["-"]`, `["--"]`, `["--A"]` all give `the following arguments are required: --a` — the bad token is never named. `unrecognized arguments:` is only reachable once `--a` has a value.
9. `-h` wins over *every* other error wherever it sits in argv (`["--b","-h"]`, `["extra","-h"]`, `["--x=1","-h"]` → help, rc 0) — EXCEPT (a) `ambiguous option` which is raised in the whole-argv pre-scan (`["-h","--=x"]` → rc 2), and (b) errors from options consumed earlier (`["-h=1","-h"]`, `["--a","-h","1"]` → rc 2).
10. `--=x` / `--=` → `ambiguous option: --=x could match --help, --a` (order = registration order, long options only).
11. `-hh`, `-h1`, `-hx` → help (single-dash tail re-parsed). `-h=1`, `--help=1`, `--h=1`, `-h-`, `-h--`, `--help=` → `argument -h/--help: ignored explicit argument '<x>'` (`''` for `--help=`). Rule: tail accepted iff not introduced by `=` and its first char isn't `-`.
12. Abbreviation: `--h`/`--he`/`--hel` → help. `--A`, `--aa`, `--a1`, `---` are unknown.
13. Exit codes: 0 success/help, **2** argparse, **1** uncaught exception. Errors are always exactly `"usage: test9_executable [-h] --a A\n" + "test9_executable: error: " + MSG + "\n"` on stderr; help is on stdout. No run ever writes both streams.
14. `--help` stdout is exactly `"usage: test9_executable [-h] --a A\n\noptions:\n  -h, --help  show this help message and exit\n  --a A\n"` (heading `options:`, help column 14, no trailing blank line). `prog` = basename(argv[0]) — hard-code `test9_executable`. `COLUMNS` re-wraps usage+help (values 1/15/20 recorded); the `error:` line itself never wraps.
15. On a YAML error **stdout is completely empty** — nothing is flushed, because `print` is in the same statement. Normal output ends with **two** `\n` (`yaml.dump` + `print`), and a **scalar/`null` root additionally emits `...`**: `x` → `"--- x\n...\n\n"`, `""`/`" "`/`"\n"`/`"# c"`/`"--- "` → `"--- null\n...\n\n"`. A *quoted* scalar root does not get `...`.
16. `MarkedYAMLError.__str__` = `\n`-join of [context, str(context_mark), problem, str(problem_mark), note], with `context_mark` **omitted when it has the same line/column as `problem_mark`**. `note` was never observed non-None.
17. Mark block = `  in "<unicode string>", line L, column C:` + snippet + caret. L/C are 1-based **code points** (`😀😀: @x` → column 5). Line breaks include `\n \r \0 U+0085 U+2028 U+2029`.
18. Snippet truncation (`indent=4, max_length=75`, threshold `>36.5`): if >36 code points precede the mark on its line, prepend `<SP>...<SP>` and keep only the last **32**; if >36 follow, keep the first **32** and append `<SP>...<SP>` (**trailing space before the newline**). Caret leading spaces = `4 + (head ? 37 : before)`. Max snippet line = 78. Pinned with before/after = 36 vs 37. Snippet copies literal TABs, so the caret visually misaligns.
19. `ReaderError` has a *different* shape — no snippet, no caret: `unacceptable character #x%04x: special characters are not allowed\n  in "<unicode string>", position P` with `P` a **0-based code-point index**, hex lowercase 4-wide. Fires in `Reader.__init__`, pre-empting all scanner/parser errors. Rejected: `\x7f`, `\x84`, `\x86`, `\x9f`, `\xfffe`; allowed: `\x7e`, `\x85`, `\xa0`, `\xfffd`. Invalid UTF-8 argv bytes surface via surrogateescape as `#xdcff`.
20. Some `!!`-tagged scalars escape as raw Python exceptions with **no mark block at all**: `!!int abc`→`ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'abc'`; `!!float xyz`→`ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'xyz'`; `!!bool xyz`→`KeyError: 'xyz'`; `!!int ""`→`IndexError: string index out of range`; `!!timestamp xyz`→`AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'groupdict'`.
21. Not errors (rc 0): duplicate mapping keys (**last wins**), `? b` explicit key, invalid escape `"a\qb"` (passes through), `%TAG ! x`, leading BOM (stripped; mid-stream BOM becomes data), `&x {a: 1, b: *x}` → re-emitted as `&id001`/`*id001`.
22. `--a=v` splits on the **first** `=` only (`--a=1=2` → value `1=2`); `--a=` and `--a ""` are identical (→ `null`); repeated `--a` → **last wins**.

OPEN QUESTIONS: PYI pid line (unfixable); per-error-site traceback frame lists have no derivable rule (only the 54 corpus sites are known); `note` field never triggered; general `COLUMNS` wrapping algorithm not derived; full surrogateescape mapping only spot-checked; ARG_MAX limits unprobed.

RULES ESTABLISHED (structure-integration) — 94 cases, 84 exit 0, 10 deliberate `*-FAIL-*` exit 1.

MOST SURPRISING FIRST

1. `yaml.dump` is called with NO Dumper arg, so it uses the **unsafe `yaml.Dumper`** while loading uses SafeLoader. Observable: `!!omap`/`!!pairs` load as lists of Python tuples and re-emit as `- !!python/tuple<NL>  - k<NL>  - v` (SafeDumper would emit a plain seq).
2. `...<NL>` is appended **iff the root node is a scalar emitted in PLAIN style**. `x`/`-1`/`null`/empty input → `--- x<NL>...<NL><NL>`; but `!!str 5` → `--- '5'<NL><NL>`, `"café"` → `--- "caf\xE9"<NL><NL>`, multi-line root → no `...`. Root collections never get it.
3. Anchor **numbering** = order of the **SECOND (duplicate) occurrence** in a depth-first walk of the already-sorted tree; the `&` is printed at the **first** occurrence. So `zzz:&A / aaa:*A / mmm:&B / bbb:*B` prints `aaa: &id002 … bbb: &id001 … mmm: *id001 … zzz: *id002`.
4. Only `dict`/`list` can be aliased. `&s hello` + `*s` emits the scalar **twice, no anchor** (ignore_aliases: None/str/bytes/bool/int/float).
5. Merge keys (`<<`) are honoured and **create aliasing that wasn't in the input**: the template's inner list/map become shared → they acquire `&id001`, while the template dict's own anchor disappears. Visible in gitlab-ci/docker-compose cases.
6. Key sort is `try: sorted(items) except TypeError: pass`. **Any incomparable key pair (str vs int, str vs None, date vs datetime) makes the WHOLE mapping fall back to dict insertion order.** int/float/bool are mutually comparable (`True`==1) and DO sort.
7. Python dict collapsing before dump: `1`/`1.0`/`true` are one key, `0`/`false` are one key; first occurrence supplies the key object, last supplies the value. `{1: int, 1.0: float, '1': str}` → `1: float<NL>'1': str`.
8. A multi-line string is single-quoted with **a BLANK LINE per value newline**: a run of n breaks emits n+1 line breaks + continuation indent. So `|`+"Line 1\nLine 2\n" → `'Line 1<NL><NL>  Line 2<NL><NL>  '`. Distinguish: emitter fold = 1 NL + indent; value newline = 2 NL + indent (both appear in one scalar in case 100).
9. A break followed by a space (or a space before a break) forbids plain AND single-quoted → **double-quoted with `\n`**: an indented shell/YAML literal block becomes `script: "if true; then\n  echo yes\nfi\n"`.
10. Explicit `? key` is forced when `len(prepared_tag)+len(key) >= 128`; `prepared_tag` counts `!!str`=5 even though unprinted, so the string-key limit is exactly **122 simple / 123 explicit** (binary-searched). Also forced for empty keys (`? ''`) and multi-line keys.
11. GitHub-Actions killer: `on:` → `true:` (YAML 1.1 bool key). Also `yes/no/On/OFF` → `true/false`.
12. Number quirks: `1e3`/`1e5`/`1.0e3`/`1.0e5` stay **strings** (float regex needs a signed exponent) while `1.0e+3` → `1000.0`; `0o17` stays a string but `017`→15, `0x1F`→31, `0b1010`→10, `1_000`→1000, `2:30`→150, `21:59:43`→79183, `190:20:30.15`→685230.15; `'09'` re-emits **plain** `09` (not a valid int per PyYAML).
13. Sequences are **not** indented under their parent key (`containers:<NL>- env:`); mappings indent 2. Only **empty** collections stay flow: `{}`/`[]` at any depth, `- [[]]` → `- - []`.
14. Fold width 80, break at a space when column > 80. Boundaries: `k: `+77 no fold / 78 folds; `- `+78/79; `--- `+76/77. Continuation indent = block indent + 2. No spaces ⇒ never folds. Double-quoted folding uses trailing `\` plus escaped leading `\ `.
15. datetime → `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS[.ffffff][±HH:MM]` (space separator, always 6-digit µs, `Z`→`+00:00`); `date` → `YYYY-MM-DD`; both plain.
16. Input side: comments, trailing spaces, blank lines, `%YAML 1.1|1.2`, `%TAG`, leading `---`, trailing `...`, BOM, CRLF and **lone CR** all accepted/normalised. But **any TAB outside quoted/block content is fatal** (even `a: 1<TAB>`), and U+00A0 is not indentation (`a:<NL><NBSP> b: 1` → key `"\_ b"`).
17. Quoting table highlights: plain — `a:b`, `-x`, `?x`, `:x`, `a#b`, `--`, `..`, `---x`, `~tilde`, `C:\path`, `$1`, `${{ }}`, `double "quoted" here`; quoted — `a: b`, `a #b`, `ab:`, `-`, `?`, `:`, `---`, `...`, leading `! & * # % @ \` > | [ ] { } , " '`, leading/trailing spaces.
18. Failures (rc 1, empty stdout): multi-document, TAB, list-as-key (`found unhashable key`), `2001-13-14` (`ValueError: month must be in 1..12` — resolver matched, constructor threw), unknown/python tags, undefined alias, duplicate anchor, bad indent. Argparse (not YAML) exits **2** if the value starts with `-`+non-digit/non-space.
19. Every successful output ends with `<NL><NL>` (dump's newline + print's).

OPEN: `!!set` with **mixed-type members is nondeterministic** (3 orderings in 8 runs — Python hash randomization + TypeError sort fallback); all-string sets are deterministic and that is what case 69 ships. All 94 shipped cases verified deterministic over 4 runs each. Per-tag length constants for non-str explicit keys, and the exact double-quoted fold boundary, are unverified.

RULES ESTABLISHED — YAML scanning/parsing for `test9_executable`

MOST SURPRISING / NON-OBVIOUS
1. **TABs are fatal almost everywhere.** `scan_to_next_token` skips only `' '`. Any TAB where a token could start → `ScannerError: found character '\t' that cannot start any token`. That includes `a:<TAB>b`, `a: b<TAB>c`, a *trailing* `a: 1<TAB>`, TAB before a `#`, TAB as indentation, TAB after a comma in flow, and a TAB-only line inside a `|` block (which ends the block, then errors). TABs are legal only inside `'…'`, `"…"`, and block-scalar bodies after the indent is stripped.
2. **`%YAML 1.2` changes nothing.** `010`→8, `yes`→true, `0o17`→str under both 1.1 and 1.2. `%YAML 2.0`/`0.9` → `ParserError: found incompatible YAML document (version 1.* is required)`. Unknown directives (`%FOO`) are silently ignored. A directive with no `---` → `expected '<document start>'`.
3. **Key sorting silently degrades to insertion order.** `yaml.dump` does `try: sorted(items) except TypeError: pass`. All-comparable keys → sorted by Python `<` on `(key, value)` tuples (`?a` < `A` < `a` < `a#b`). Any str/int, str/bool, str/None mix → **document order preserved**, decided per mapping.
4. **`--- a: 1` is an ERROR** (`mapping values are not allowed here`), and `--- - a` is `sequence entries are not allowed here`, because `---` sets `allowSimpleKey = false`. But `--- foo`, `--- {a:1}`, `--- [1,2]`, `--- |`, `--- &a 1`, `--- !!str 1` all work.
5. **Non-specific tag `!` forces implicit resolution regardless of style**: `! 1`→int 1, `! yes`→true, **`! '1'`→int 1**.
6. **`>` does NOT strip trailing spaces before folding**: `>` over `"  x  " / "  y"` yields `"x   y\n"` (3 spaces).
7. **A block scalar's explicit indent indicator is RELATIVE to the enclosing block indent**: `contentIndent = scannerIndent + n` (root: `scannerIndent = -1` → `contentIndent = n`). `a:\n  b: |2` → indent 4, not 2. `|0` → `expected indentation indicator in the range 1-9`; `|10` and `|--` → `expected chomping or indentation indicators`. `|2-` and `|-2` both legal.
8. **Auto-detected block indent = indentation of the FIRST non-empty line.** `a: |\n    x\n  y` errors (indent 4; `  y` ends the block, then `expected <block end>, but found '<scalar>'`). Same for `|4` with 2-space content.
9. **U+2028/U+2029 are line breaks but are NOT normalised** — they survive verbatim into scalars (`a: x<LS>  y` → `"x\u2028y"`), whereas `\r`, `\r\n`, and **U+0085 (NEL)** all normalise to `\n` and fold to a space.
10. **BOM does not advance the column counter**, and only a BOM at index 0 is stripped; elsewhere it is scalar content (`a:\n ﻿ b: 1` → key `"\uFEFF b"` at indent 1).
11. **Simple-key limit is exactly `index - keyStart > 1024`.** Block key of 1024 `k` OK, 1025 → `mapping values are not allowed here` at col 1026. In flow, `{`+1024 OK (span counts from after `{`), 1030 → `expected ',' or '}', but got ':'`. Quotes count toward the span.
12. **"required simple key" produces a weird error.** If a discarded stale key sat at `column == current block indent`, you get `while scanning a simple key … could not find expected ':'` pointing at EOF. Hits `a:\n1`, `a:\n  b: one\n  two`, `a: one\n---- x`, `a\nb: 1`.
13. **Reader-level printability check runs on the whole string before parsing**: class `[\t\n\r\x20-\x7E\x85\xA0-\uD7FF\uE000-\uFFFD\u{10000}-\u{10FFFF}]`; first violation → `ReaderError: unacceptable character #xNNNN … position N` (**0-based codepoint index**). `\x0B`/`\x0C` are rejected as raw bytes even though `\v`/`\f` are valid escapes.

REST OF THE MODEL (condensed)
14. `allowSimpleKey` state machine drives most errors: set true at stream start / after a block-context line break / after `[ { , - |` `>`; set false after `%dir`, `---`, `...`, `] }`, `:`, `& * !`, quoted, plain. `-`/`?`/`:` with it false → `sequence entries` / `mapping keys` / `mapping values are not allowed here`.
15. `:` ends a plain scalar iff followed by space/TAB/break/EOF, plus (flow only) `, [ ] { }`. In flow a plain scalar also ends at any of `, ? [ ] { }`. So `a:b` is one scalar, `[a:]`→`[{a:null}]`, `{a: b:}` errors, `a:: 1`→key `a:`.
16. Cannot start a plain scalar: `, [ ] { }` → `expected the node content, but found '<c>'`; `@ ` `` ` `` `%` → `cannot start any token`. All are fine mid-scalar.
17. Plain folding: 1 break → `' '`; n blank lines → n `\n`; internal space runs preserved verbatim; trailing spaces dropped. Continuation needs `column >= blockIndent + 1` (root indent −1 → col 0 OK). A col-0 `---`/`...` (followed by space/break/EOF) terminates it; 4 dashes do not.
18. `#` is a comment only at token start or after ≥1 space; `a#b` and `b#c` stay literal. A comment on a plain-scalar continuation line terminates the scalar.
19. Double-quoted escapes accepted: `\0 \a \b \t \<TAB> \n \v \f \r \e \" \\ \/ \<SP> \N \_ \L \P \xHH \uHHHH \UHHHHHHHH`; `\<NL>` = continuation dropping the break and the next line's leading whitespace. Bad escape → `found unknown escape character 'q'`; short hex → `expected escape sequence of N hexadecimal numbers`.
20. Chomping: clip = value + last break; strip = value; keep = value + last break + trailing empty-line breaks. **No final break in the input → all three give the same result** (`|+\n  x` → `"x"`). A block line with fewer spaces than the indent is an empty line; with more, the extras are content.
21. Flow: trailing commas fine; `[1, , 2]` / `[,]` / `{,}` error; `{a: , b, d:}` gives nulls; `?` works in flow mappings and `[? a]`→`[{a:null}]`; block indicators (`-`, `|`) inside flow error.
22. Indentless sequences under a mapping key are allowed, but only relative to their **own** parent key (`a:\n  b:\n- 1` errors with `expected <block end>, but found '-'`).
23. Anchors: name `[0-9A-Za-z_-]+`, must be followed by one of `\0 SP TAB break ? : , ] } % @ ` `` ` ``; `&x.y` → `expected alphabetic or numeric character`. Duplicate anchor → `found duplicate anchor 'x'; first/second occurrence`. Aliasing a collection yields the **same object** (dumped `&id001`/`*id001`); recursion works. Anchor on an empty node → null. `<<` merge works, incl. `[*x,*y]` (earlier wins, explicit keys win); non-map → `expected a mapping or list of mappings for merging`.
24. Tags: `!!foo`, `!local`, `!!python/*` → `ConstructorError: could not determine a constructor for the tag '…'`; wrong kind → `expected a scalar/mapping/sequence node, but found …`; `%XX` decoded in tag URIs; `!!` alone → `expected URI`; duplicate `%TAG` handle → `duplicate tag handle`.
25. Documents: two documents → `ComposerError: expected a single document in the stream … but found another document`; content after `...` → `expected '<document start>'`; bare `...` → `expected the node content, but found '<document end>'`; empty/whitespace/comment-only input → `--- null\n...\n`.
26. Output framing needed for replay: `---` always; `--- <scalar>` for scalar roots; trailing `...` **only** when the root was written as a plain scalar; `print()` adds one extra newline; keys ≥128 chars / empty / multi-line are emitted as `? k\n: v`.
27. Process contract: success RC=0; any YAML error RC=1 with **empty stdout**; stderr ends with a nondeterministic `[PYI-<n>:ERROR]` line, so only RC + stdout are byte-comparable. Values starting with `-` and containing no ASCII space (e.g. `---`, `-`) are rejected by argparse with RC=2 before YAML ever runs.

Spec: `/workspace/dev/spec/scanner-parser.md` (690 lines). Cases: `/workspace/dev/cases/scanner-parser/01..123-*.txt` (68 success, 55 error, all verified deterministic and none hitting argparse RC=2). Replay recorder: `/workspace/dev/_sp/record.js`, captured output `/workspace/dev/_sp/rec2.txt`.
